meta_description:
547 likes, 2 comments - bigleemurali on October 7, 2026: "Turning 40 isn’t the problem. Ignoring your body for the next 20 years is.
At 25, you can get away with poor sleep, inactivity, stress, low protein and unhealthy habits.
At 40+, those choices start showing up in your strength, muscle mass, mobility, recovery, hormones and metabolic health.
Your body keeps the receipts.
Don’t wait for the bill. Start investing in your health now.
#HealthyAfter40 #StrengthTraining #HealthyAging #MuscleAfter40 #Longevity".
